project_info.theme: Four-panel dark-red satin analog fashion collage
project_info.color_palette: deep red, burgundy, warm brown, neutral gray, satin highlight

main_subject.detail: An adult woman with softly waved slightly tousled dark hair, minimal warm makeup, natural skin texture, and an elegant feminine silhouette. She wears a deep-red satin slip dress with thin straps, a side slit, and a visible back-tie detail.

items: one square image containing four equal rectangular panels in a clean grid
panel one: relaxed half-body portrait against neutral gray with slight movement blur
panel two: three-quarter over-shoulder glance against dark red, hand near collarbone, gently soft focus
panel three: half-body upward head tilt against dark red with stronger artistic motion blur
panel four: close detail of back/side torso showing satin folds and back-tie strings against neutral gray
all panels retain consistent deep-red analog color and grain

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: warm low tungsten practical light, approximately 3000K
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: soft shadows, gentle bloom on satin highlights, selective clarity across the dress texture

technical_specs.render_style: Canon AE-1 film look, 50mm f/1.8, soft focus with selective satin highlight clarity
technical_specs.color_treatment: deep reds and warm browns, low-to-medium contrast, analog grain, halation, soft bloom, mild vignette

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create one square four-panel analog fashion-editorial collage featuring an adult woman with softly waved slightly tousled dark hair, minimal warm makeup, natural skin texture, and an elegant feminine silhouette. She wears a deep-red satin slip dress with thin straps, a side slit, and a visible back-tie detail. Panel one is a relaxed half-body portrait against neutral gray with slight movement blur. Panel two is a three-quarter over-shoulder glance against dark red, with a hand near the collarbone and gentle soft focus. Panel three is a half-body upward head tilt against dark red with stronger artistic motion blur. Panel four is a close back/side detail showing the satin folds and back-tie strings against neutral gray. Keep the same deep-red analog color and grain across all panels. Use warm low tungsten practical light at approximately 3000K for soft shadows and gentle bloom on satin highlights. Canon AE-1 film look, 50mm f/1.8, soft focus with selective satin highlight clarity, deep reds and warm browns, low-to-medium contrast, analog grain, halation, soft bloom, mild vignette, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, body measurements, text, logo, watermark, ultra-sharp digital look, HDR, neon colors, plastic skin, over-retouched beauty, extra fingers, deformed anatomy, low resolution, heavy artifacts

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: The optional moodboard preserves the four-panel arrangement, deep-red satin slip dress, thin straps, side slit, back-tie detail, red/gray backgrounds, and analog treatment. An approved-adult identity reference may replace the subject; preserve her face, facial structure, and likeness. Keep the exact dress construction when a wardrobe reference is attached; other environment details may change while retaining the four-panel film collage.
